• Ability Scores: Dexterity, Intelligence, Charisma
  • Feat: Tireless Reveler
  • Skill Proficiencies: Deception and Persuasion
  • Tool Proficiency: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
  • Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Dagger, Gaming Set (same as above), Fine Clothes, Glass Bottle, Mirror, Perfume, Pouch, Tinderbox, 19 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Suggested Characteristics

You grew to adulthood in the beating heart of a large city, such as Scrimshaw City or Nova Jersaeria. You spent countless evenings in taverns, playhouses, parlors, and gambling dens, savoring all the city had to offer. You're a natural at interacting with people to learn their secrets, whether over a high-stakes game or at a high-class soiree. You might have been thrown out of an establishment or ten, but only by people who don't know how to party.

d6I became a carouser because...
1For me, currying favor with powerful folk has always been easier than working a job.
2My musical career never took off, but my drinking career is practically bubbling over.
3I am trying to drum up support for a revolution of some sort.
4I have inherited enough gold to be comfortably unemployed.
5My friends are always hanging around the tavern, and I would be lost without them.
6My family cast me out, so I found a new support network: strangers at the tavern.
d8Personality Trait
1At the end of each night, I tally up the number of good stories I have heard.
2I use crude humor to shield myself from the dreadful fate life has dealt me.
3I know all the hip buzzwords and slang that the kids are using these days.
4I know of every drinking game in the realm, but I don't know any of the rules.
5I am far too generous with my coin for someone without a profession.
6I constantly need to be locked into conversation with someone.
7I am exceedingly tolerant of the different faiths of the world, though I get them all jumbled.
8I am bad with names but I remember secrets quite well.
d6Ideal
1Fellowship. Life (and drinks) are always better when shared with bosom friends. (Good)
2Charity. It is virtuous to buy the next round. (Good)
3Revolution. The hierarchic systems of this world must be brought down. (Chaotic)
4Influence. Those who sit and laugh with powerful folk have an easier time influencing future affairs. (Lawful)
5Deception. The secrets you learn from others should be sold for personal gain. (Evil)
6Revelry. Life is short, and it is best spent partying. (Chaotic)
d6Bond
1I would die rather than give up my stool at the tavern.
2If I ever become famous, I will not forget those who drank with me.
3I owe a massive tab at a tavern across the city and the owner is always finding me and beating me up.
4I only drink one kind of ale, it's my favorite.
5I basically get into the same debate with the same tavern patron every night.
6I am devoted to a revolution that will shake the foundations of the tavern. And the world.
d8Flaw
1I condescend to make myself seem smarter than I am.
2I overshare far too much.
3I can be convinced of almost anything by just about anyone.
4I have never left the streets where I was born.
5I am suspicious of anyone without a drink in their hand.
6I am a terrible listener.
7I am a mean drunk.
8I simply cannot handle adversity.

• Ability Scores: Constitution, Wisdom, Charisma
  • Feat: Alert
  • Skill Proficiencies: Insight, Perception
  • Tool Proficiency: Choose one kind of Musical Instrument
  • Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Musical Instrument (same as above), Dagger, Rope, Bedroll, Traveler's Clothes, Pouch, Tent, poorly wrought maps from your homeland that depict where you are, a small piece of jewelry in the style of your homeland's craftsmanship, 20 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Suggested Characteristics

You are from a distant place, one so remote that few common folk realize that it exists, and chances are good that even if some people you meet have heard of your homeland, they know merely the name and perhaps a few outrageous stories. You have come to this part of Selerim for your own reasons, which you might or might not choose to share.

d6I became a far traveler because...
1I am an emissary from a far-flung nation, seeking alliances and knowledge to bring back to my homeland.
2I was exiled for my beliefs, my actions, or a crime. Now I wander in search of a new purpose.
3A desperate flight from justice left me with no choice but to keep moving, lest I be caught.
4Faith and prophecy sent me on a sacred journey, one that takes me ever farther from home.
5I am a sightseer of sorts, desperate to soak up all the magnificent views this world has to offer.
6The road calls to me, and I have never felt content staying in one place for long.
d6Personality Trait
1I have different assumptions from those around me concerning personal space, blithely invading others' space in innocence, or reacting to ignorant invasion of my own.
2I have my own ideas about what is and is not food, and I find the eating habits of those around me fascinating, confusing, or revolting.
3I have a strong code of honor or sense of propriety that others don't comprehend.
4I express affection or contempt in ways that are unfamiliar to others.
5I honor my deities through practices that are foreign to this land.
6I begin or end my day with small traditional rituals that are unfamiliar to those around me.
d6Ideal
1Open. I have much to learn from the kindly folk I meet along my way. (Good)
2Reserved. As someone new to these strange lands, I am cautious and respectful in my dealings. (Lawful)
3Adventure. I'm far from home, and everything is strange and wonderful! (Chaotic)
4Cunning. Though I may not know their ways, neither do they know mine, which can be to my advantage. (Evil)
5Inquisitive. Everything is new, but I have a thirst to learn. (Neutral)
6Suspicious. I must be careful, for I have no way of telling friend from foe here. (Any)
d6Bond
1So long as I have this token from my homeland, I can face any adversity in this strange land.
2The gods of my people are a comfort to me so far away from home.
3I hold no greater cause than my service to my people.
4My freedom is my most precious possession. I'll never let anyone take it from me again.
5I'm fascinated by the beauty and wonder of this new land.
6Though I had no choice, I lament having to leave my loved one(s) behind. I hope to see them again one day.
d6Flaw
1I am secretly (or not so secretly) convinced of the superiority of my own culture over that of this foreign land.
2I pretend not to understand the local language in order to avoid interactions I would rather not have.
3I have a weakness for the new intoxicants and other pleasures of this land.
4I don't take kindly to some of the actions and motivations of the people of this land, because these folks are different from me.
5I consider the adherents of other gods to be deluded innocents at best, or ignorant fools at worst.
6I have a weakness for the exotic beauty of the people of these lands.

• Ability Scores: Strength, Wisdom, Charisma
  • Feat: Tavern Brawler
  • Skill Proficiencies: Athletics, Survival
  • Tool Proficiency: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools
  • Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan's Tools (same as above), Shovel, Iron Pot, Rope, Traveler's Clothes, Pouch, a memento from your village, 20 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Suggested Characteristics

You come from a humble social rank, but you are destined for so much more. Already the people of your home village regard you as their champion, and your destiny calls you to stand against the tyrants and monsters that threaten the common folk everywhere.

d6I became a folk hero because...
1I learned what was right and wrong from my family.
2I was always enamored by tales of heroes and wished I could be something more than ordinary.
3I hated my mundane life, so when it was time for someone to step up and do the right thing, I took my chance.
4A parent or one of my relatives was an adventurer, and I was inspired by that person's courage.
5A mad old hermit spoke a prophecy when I was born, saying that I would accomplish great things.
6I have always stood up for those who are weaker than I am.
d8Personality Trait
1I judge people by their actions, not their words.
2If someone is in trouble, I'm always ready to lend help.
3When I set my mind to something, I follow through no matter what gets in my way.
4I have a strong sense of fair play and always try to find the most equitable solution to arguments.
5I'm confident in my own abilities and do what I can to instill confidence in others.
6Thinking is for other people. I prefer action.
7I misuse long words in an attempt to sound smarter.
8I get bored easily. When am I going to get on with my destiny?
d6Ideal
1Respect. People deserve to be treated with dignity and respect. (Good)
2Fairness. No one should get preferential treatment before the law, and no one is above the law. (Lawful)
3Freedom. Tyrants must not be allowed to oppress the people. (Chaotic)
4Might. If I become strong, I can take what I want, and what I want is what I deserve. (Evil)
5Sincerity. There's no good in pretending to be something I'm not. (Neutral)
6Destiny. Nothing and no one can steer me away from my higher calling. (Any)
d6Bond
1I have a family, but I have no idea where they are. One day, I hope to see them again.
2I worked the land, I love the land, and I will protect the land.
3A proud noble once gave me a horrible beating, and I will take my revenge on any bully I encounter.
4My tools are symbols of my past life, and I carry them so that I will never forget my roots.
5I protect those who cannot protect themselves.
6I wish my childhood sweetheart had come with me to pursue my destiny.
d6Flaw
1The tyrant who rules my land will stop at nothing to see me killed.
2I'm convinced of the significance of my destiny, and blind to my shortcomings and the risk of failure.
3The people who knew me when I was young know my shameful secret, so I can never go home again.
4I have a weakness for the vices of the city, especially hard drink.
5Secretly, I believe that things would be better if I were a tyrant lording over the land.
6I have trouble trusting in my allies.

• Ability Scores: Dexterity, Wisdom, Charisma
  • Feat: Lucky
  • Skill Proficiencies: Deception, Insight
  • Tool Proficiencies: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
  • Equipment: Gaming Set (same as above), a lucky charm, a set of fine clothes, and a belt pouch containing 15 gp; or (B) 50 GP
Suggested Characteristics

All you need to make a lot of gold is a little gold, except when you have no gold. Whether you're a good gambler or a bad one rarely matters, as few can predict the divine whims of Lady Luck. Sometimes you're up and sometimes you're down, but you always know that someone, somewhere, is always willing to take a bet.

Some gamble out of necessity. Others do so out of boredom. Still others become addicted to the thrill of uncertainty. Even the best gamblers are one hand away from financial ruin, and the worst gamblers are one wager away from untold fortunes. As a gambler, you are blessed by Lady Luck with an inherent need to bet, wager, and take the occasional foolhardy risk.

d6I became a gambler because...
1Lady Luck whispered in my ear the first time I rolled the dice, and I've been chasing her ever since.
2I grew up with nothing, and the allure of turning rags into riches was too tempting to resist.
3I once bet everything on a single game. And I and won. Ever since, I've believed the odds are always in my favor.
4The rush of outsmarting opponents and taking risks makes me feel more alive than anything else.
5A fortune-teller told me that luck would guide my destiny, and gambling seemed the best way to test it.
6I learned to gamble to survive, turning every coin and every game into a chance to eat another meal.
d8Personality Trait
1I plan for every contingency. Leave nothing to chance!
2Every copper wants to be a silver. Each bet is an opportunity.
3I'm one of Lady Luck's favored. Anything I try is destined to succeed.
4I've lost so much to gambling that I refuse to spend money on anything anymore.
5Nothing is certain. Planning is a coward's act.
6I can't be sure who I've swindled, cheated, or defeated, so I keep a low profile in public.
7The perfect bet is out there somewhere. I just have to keep my eyes open.
8I have beaten my addiction, but all it takes is one weak moment and I'll be back at the card table.
d6Ideal
1Knowledge. Knowledge is power, and knowing which horse to back is the key to success. (Any)
2Fate. Whatever happens is fated, regardless of any planning or striving. (Lawful)
3Bravery. If you want to succeed, you have to take risks. (Chaotic)
4Survival. You can't win if you're dead. Live to fight another day when the odds might be more in your favor. (Any)
5Reliability. When I was in need, I was able to rely on others. Now I want to be the one others rely on. (Good)
6Victory. Winning is the real measure of a person. In the end, the only thing that matters is the scoreboard. (Evil)
d6Bond
1One person in particular owes me a lot of money, and I need to keep them alive if I want to be repaid.
2I'm loyal to the friend or family member who taught me how to gamble.
3The person who saved me from my gambling addiction is the only reason I'm alive today.
4A patron once fronted me money in exchange for a percentage of my winnings. I owe them a debt of gratitude. And a lot of cash.
5A criminal syndicate I once played for isn't happy I left the game, and its enforcers are looking for me.
6Urchins once helped me find marks for my games. Now I'm driven to help them escape the streets.
d6Flaw
1I don't know when to quit. Especially when everyone else is telling me to.
2I save my sympathy for my friends, and I have no friends.
3You think we're in trouble now? Let me tell you how bad things are likely to get!
4You can loan me a little, right? I've got a sure thing. I'll double your money, guaranteed.
5I was once a terribly flawed person, like you. Let me tell you how you can save yourself.
6I'm a great gambler. I'm just bad at math and logic.

• Ability Scores: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence
  • Feat: Lucky
  • Skill Proficiencies: Deception, History
  • Tool Proficiency: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
  • Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) two Gaming Set of your choice, Bedroll, Bucket, Jug, Traveler's Clothes, Backpack, an unused punch card from a job you quit, an unopened self-help pamphlet, 5 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Suggested Characteristics

As a NEAT (Not in Employment, Adventuring, or Training), you might be either loafing, burned out, or just between things. You never got your invitation to mage school, your warrior dreams died in basic training, and your adventuring resume is a blank sheet. You have no training, no references, and no marketable skills. This world is a confusing place, and you're muddling through it one awkward mistake at a time.

d6I became a NEAT because...
1I dropped out of my apprenticeship to pursue a gaming career, which went nowhere.
2I kept leaving jobs until the townsfolk stopped hiring me.
3I kind of just don't give a shit.
4My parents kind of just forgot to encourage me to better myself.
5My application to mage school was rejected, big time.
6My dreams of being a powerful fighter died when I blew out my knee.
d8Personality Trait
1I confidently walk into every situation, even when I have no idea what's happening.
2I will talk for hours about lore, especially to people who are uninterested.
3I have many contradicting opinions from the scrolls I read in my spare time.
4I constantly lie about my education and work history.
5I have a refined sense of taste, but only when it comes to chicken tenders.
6I approach every task with reckless optimism and zero follow-through.
7I always assume someone else is in charge, and I always need to be told what to do.
8I think I'm being gangstalked. I might be. I'm not sure.
d6Ideal
1Freedom. I don't want to be tied down by expectations or employment. (Chaotic)
2Comfort. I avoid danger, discomfort, and expectations wherever possible. (Neutral)
3Ignorance. If I don't know I'm in danger, it can't hurt me. (Neutral)
4Improvisation. Planning is just failure in slow motion. (Chaotic)
5Nonchalance. If I don't care, I can't be disappointed. (Neutral)
6Delusion. I am destined for greatness, probably. (Any)
d6Bond
1Don't tell them this, but I owe everything to my parents for letting me crash in their cellar.
2I carry a badge from a job I got fired from. I pretend it's a medal.
3I once promised a tavern owner I'd return with rent. I haven't. I must never go back.
4One of my cousins is mildly famous, and I constantly reference them as if that gives me credibility.
5I still send messages to my old party even though they left me behind three quests ago.
6Someone gave me a map. I assume it leads to treasure, but I just haven't had the time to check.
d6Flaw
1I am constantly falling for pyramid schemes and cults.
2I've become too comfortable lying to friends and family about my employment status.
3I sabotage myself the moment something starts going well.
4I run from problems instead of solving them. Sometimes literally.
5I insist I can do things I clearly can't, like swordplay or basic arithmetic.
6I have absolutely no sense of time or direction.

• Ability Scores: Strength, Constitution, Charisma
  • Feat: Savage Attacker or Tavern Brawler
  • Skill Proficiencies: Athletics, Intimidation
  • Tool Proficiencies: Navigator's Tools
  • Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Navigator's Tools, Dagger, Traveler's Clothes, Rope, 20 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Suggested Characteristics

You spent your youth under the sway of a dread pirate, a ruthless cutthroat who taught you how to survive in a world of sharks and savages. You've indulged in larceny on the high seas and sent more than one deserving soul to a briny grave. Fear and bloodshed are no strangers to you, and you've garnered a somewhat unsavory reputation in many a port town.

d6I became a pirate because...
1I grew up by the sea, and the allure of adventure and freedom on the open waves was irresistible.
2A pirate crew took me in when I was destitute, and I earned my keep among them.
3I was wrongfully accused of a crime and had no choice but to flee to the seas.
4The promise of riches and plunder drew me to piracy like a moth to flame.
5I sought vengeance against those who wronged me, and the pirate life offered the means to achieve it.
6I was betrayed by someone I trusted and found a home among outlaws who understood my pain.
d8Personality Trait
1My friends know they can rely on me, no matter what.
2I work hard so that I can play hard when the work is done.
3I enjoy sailing into new ports and making new friends over a flagon of ale.
4I stretch the truth for the sake of a good story.
5To me, a tavern brawl is a nice way to get to know a new city.
6I never pass up a friendly wager.
7My language is as foul as an otyugh nest.
8I like a job well done, especially if I can convince someone else to do it.
d6Ideal
1Respect. The thing that keeps a ship together is mutual respect between captain and crew. (Good)
2Fairness. We all do the work, so we all share in the rewards. (Lawful)
3Freedom. The sea is freedom—the freedom to go anywhere and do anything. (Chaotic)
4Mastery. I'm a predator, and the other ships on the sea are my prey. (Evil)
5People. I'm committed to my crewmates, not to ideals. (Neutral)
6Aspiration. Someday, I'll own my own ship and chart my own destiny. (Any)
d6Bond
1I'm loyal to my captain first, everything else second.
2The ship is most important—crewmates and captains come and go.
3I'll always remember my first ship.
4In a harbor town, I have a paramour whose eyes nearly stole me from the sea.
5I was cheated out of my fair share of the profits, and I want to get my due.
6Ruthless pirates murdered my captain and crewmates, plundered our ship, and left me to die. Vengeance will be mine.
d6Flaw
1I follow orders, even if I think they're wrong.
2I'll say anything to avoid having to do extra work.
3Once someone questions my courage, I never back down no matter how dangerous the situation.
4Once I start drinking, it's hard for me to stop.
5I can't help but pocket loose coins and other trinkets I come across.
6My pride will probably lead to my destruction.

• Ability Scores: Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma
  • Feat: Magic Initiate (Cleric) or Magic Initiate (Druid) or Magic Initiate (Wizard)
  • Skill Proficiencies: History, Investigation
  • Tool Proficiencies: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools
  • Equipment: Artisan's Tools (same as above), Fine Clothes, Ink Pen, Ink, Book, 5 pages of paper, Ledger of Student Debt (50 gp owed to your academic institution)
Suggested Characteristics

You immersed yourself in the study of a particular field, dedicating countless hours to the pursuit of knowledge. Whether at a prestigious academy, a secluded druidic circle, a seminary devoted to divine teachings, or even a bard college, your education has granted you insight into the arcane, natural, or divine. This rigorous training allows you to grasp the fundamentals of magic, blending scholarship and practice. Though your studies have often kept you from the broader world, your education and keen mind now prepare you to face its challenges. Whether by circumstance or choice, you now carry your lessons into the unknown.

d6I became a student because...
1A pivotal experience, such as discovering an ancient artifact or surviving a calamity, ignited my thirst for knowledge.
2I became fixated on a specific mystery, theory, or craft, and my studies began as an attempt to unravel it.
3My family pushed me toward academic excellence, believing it was the path to success and prestige.
4My studies provided a refuge from a difficult home life or dangerous environment.
5I have always been fascinated by the mysteries of the world and couldn't resist the call to learn more.
6A brilliant mentor recognized my potential and encouraged me to pursue my studies.
d8Personality Trait
1I struggle with social cues, preferring books and theories over people.
2I am forgetful of things like meals or sleep when immersed in a fascinating subject.
3I see the world as a grand experiment and often approach situations analytically rather than emotionally.
4I tend to correct people's mistakes, even when it annoys them.
5I view every challenge as a puzzle to be solved, regardless of how impractical that may be.
6I quote famous scholars and their works in conversations, even if no one else understands them.
7I carry a notebook and write down everything I find interesting, from magical theories to mundane gossip.
8I am always seeking to learn, asking endless questions about everything and everyone.
d6Ideal
1Knowledge. The pursuit of knowledge is the noblest goal. (Neutral)
2Curiosity. I believe that questioning everything is the path to true understanding. (Chaotic)
3Improvement. Learning is a means to better myself and the world. (Good)
4Ambition. I strive to become the foremost expert in my field of study. (Neutral)
5Logic. Emotions are distractions; logic and reason must prevail. (Lawful)
6Domination. Knowledge is power, and I will use it to bend others to my will. (Evil)
d6Bond
1I owe everything to a mentor who recognized my potential and pushed me to succeed.
2A rival student humiliated me once, and I seek to surpass them in every way.
3I feel responsible for protecting a rare book or artifact entrusted to me.
4My family sacrificed much to support my studies, and I want to make them proud.
5I am dedicated to proving a controversial theory that no one else believes in.
6I long to return to my place of study, where I felt most at home.
d6Flaw
1I am so focused on learning that I neglect practical concerns, like personal safety or well-being.
2I am overly critical of those who I believe are less intelligent or educated than me.
3I find it difficult to admit when I'm wrong, even in the face of overwhelming evidence.
4I hoard knowledge, refusing to share what I've learned with others.
5I can become fixated on a problem or mystery to the point of obsession.
6I often disregard rules or traditions that I see as outdated or irrelevant.
